# XYREG

> Medical device regulatory management platform for QMS, design controls, risk management, and global market submissions (MDR, FDA, PMDA, ANVISA, and more).

XYREG helps medtech companies plan, document, and submit medical devices across global markets through an integrated quality management system, design control workflows, risk management (ISO 14971), and a regulatory dossier engine.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Platform overview and value proposition for medtech regulatory teams.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Subscription plans and pricing for XYREG.
- [Register](/register): Create a XYREG account.
